name: FNP Technologies SA
summary: FNP Technologies SA provides software development, computer networks, and training and assistance services to the hotel industry. It offers FlipNpik, a collaborative social network to promote local businesses; and MAST, a software for reservation and billing management, multi-channel distribution, and decision support. The company was formerly known as Multimicrocloud SA and changed its name to FNP Technologies SA in July 2021. FNP Technologies SA was founded in 1986 and is based in Valbonne, France.
